desc: The class-leading Chicro light is all grown up. The Chicro XL, pushing boundaries with an impressive 500 lumens in a slim, lightweight package. Ideal for automotive repairs, camping, everyday carry, or emergency situations, this convenient task light fits perfectly in your pocket, bedside drawer, or car. With dual output capability (high/low), and momentary or constant-on functionality, the Chicro XL can be adapted to nearly any task. The integrated USB-C port allows for convenient charging while on-the-go and eliminates the need for separate devices.
